annotation.description: The video is taken from the air. In the lower left corner there is a black bag maybe from a paragliders foot. The scene shows white cliffs on top of which there grows green grass. On the cliff is a golf course. On the left there is the sea. In the first cliff that stands out in the sea a natural passage by a small beach. On the top of this first cliff are people. In the background there is a small town/ village by the sea and more cliffs and one very pointy rock in the sea
